papers.abstract: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action's outcome and failure mode against this intent. Our action-level analysis demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents on direct robot control, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation. It also identifies their current limitations, including task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks such as grasping and alignment, and uneven recovery across failure modes. Finally, we validate our critic on a 400-action human-annotated benchmark and release a dataset of 12,844 annotated actions alongside a fine-tuned open-source critic, Muse-Glimmer-30B, whose failure-mode accuracy rises from 32.58% to 74.24%, enabling low-cost action-level analysis.

analysis.key_results: 前沿智能体具备局部执行失败后的闭环恢复、跨场景语义对齐和零样本操纵能力；但存在抓取、对齐等物理执行瓶颈，且不同失败模式的恢复能力不均衡；Muse-Glimmer-30B失败模式准确率达74.24%。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入意图锚定的批判框架AgentRoboCritic，系统分析前沿智能体在直接机器人控制中的动作级表现，识别能力与局限，并发布12,844条标注动作数据集和微调模型Muse-Glimmer-30B，将失败模式识别准确率从32.58%提升至74.24%。
analysis.method: 策略智能体在输出每个动作时附带局部意图，批判器基于该意图评估动作结果与失败模式；在12个操纵基准上开展动作级分析，并使用400动作人工标注基准验证批判器。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出AgentRoboCritic框架，对前沿多模态语言智能体在直接机器人控制任务上的行为进行动作级分析和失败模式评估，并发布标注数据集与开源批判模型。

papers.abstract: Acquiring every feature of an instance is often costly: a measurement can carry a monetary price, a time delay, or a privacy cost. Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) addresses this by learning a policy that decides, per instance, which features to acquire under a budget. Existing AFA methods train this policy by optimizing a self-constructed utility target rather than distilling an explicit teacher. We construct this teacher explicitly. At training time the label and the unobserved feature values are available, and together they determine the teacher in closed form: an oracle that ranks every candidate by its effect on the downstream predictor's error. OracleImitator distills this ranking into a deployable policy by soft-target imitation. Across multimodal medical diagnosis and the AFABench benchmark, OracleImitator matches or outperforms existing AFA methods across the budget range, recovering 90% of the attainable accuracy gain at under a quarter of the acquisition cost. Because the teacher is an explicit algorithmic object rather than an implicit optimization target, we can also measure directly how much of its ranking is recoverable by a policy restricted to what is visible at deployment.

analysis.key_results: 在多模态医学诊断和 AFABench 基准上匹配或优于现有主动特征获取方法，以不到四分之一的获取成本恢复了 90% 的可实现准确率增益。

papers.abstract: Robotic vision-language-action (VLA) models can execute diverse individual manipulation skills, yet they still struggle with long-horizon loco-manipulation tasks, where temporal structure, skills, and precision are tightly coupled within a monolithic model. We propose Physically Grounded Execution (PGX), a framework that offloads temporal and precision control to two classical training-free components, allowing the VLA to focus on stage-specific skill dynamics. PGX decomposes long-horizon loco-manipulation into three layers: (i) a predicate-based state machine governs task progression, using physical predicates to gate phase transitions, trigger recovery, and coordinate navigation and waiting. Shared predicate semantics connect offline demonstration segmentation, online execution, and stage-wise evaluation; (ii) VLA skills operate within active manipulation phases, with flat or stage-trained models concentrating on task-relevant actions; and (iii) world-coordinate locking (WCL) maintains spatial consistency through base station keeping, object-relative positioning, and world-anchored contact targets. We demonstrate the effectiveness of PGX with extensive experiments conducted on three simulated tasks and one real-world task using a Unitree G1 humanoid robot for long-horizon loco-manipulation, showing improvements in stage progression and task success rates. Project page is available at: https://kl-research.github.io/pgx

analysis.key_results: 在三个仿真任务和一个使用 Unitree G1 人形机器人的真实任务上进行了广泛实验，显示阶段进展和任务成功率有所提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出物理接地执行（PGX）框架，将长时序移动操作任务分解为基于谓词的状态机、VLA 技能和世界坐标锁定三层，从而提升任务成功率和阶段进展。
analysis.method: PGX 框架：谓词状态机管理任务进展并触发恢复；VLA 技能在主动操作阶段执行；世界坐标锁定通过基座保持、物体相对定位和世界锚定接触目标维持空间一致性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PGX 通过将时间与精度控制卸载给两个经典免训练组件，使 VLA 专注于阶段特定技能动态，从而提升长时序人形机器人移动操作任务的性能。

papers.abstract: Reliable reasoning for long-horizon embodied tasks requires predictions grounded in the observed execution state. We present ACE-Brain-0.7, a 9B vision--language model that combines spatial grounding, task understanding, and progress estimation. To train the model, we curate 3.7 million question--answer pairs, drawing execution supervision from egocentric human videos, robot episodes, and simulation. These questions span different stages of an execution and connect task-level judgments with observed progress and outcomes. We then fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B on this collection together with additional task, spatial-grounding, and progress-estimation data. Across six public task-reasoning benchmarks, ACE-Brain-0.7 achieves an average score of 76.5, ahead of GPT-6 Astra at 72.7 and Claude Opus 5.5 at 73.5. Our model also leads the evaluated models in spatial grounding, averaging 75.90 across seven benchmarks and reaching 91.25 Acc@0.5 on RefCOCOg. Controlled evaluations further indicate that our task-only model makes more effective use of visual history and more accurately distinguishes execution states. Together, these results show that ACE-Brain-0.7 effectively combines spatial perception with temporal understanding, delivering strong execution-grounded reasoning and comparing favorably with closed-source models.

analysis.key_results: 在六个公共任务推理基准上平均得分 76.5，超过 GPT-6 Astra (72.7) 和 Claude Opus 5.5 (73.5)；在七个空间定位基准上平均得分 75.90，并在 RefCOCOg 上达到 91.25 Acc@0.5；控制评估表明任务模型更有效地利用视觉历史并更准确地区分执行状态。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: ACE-Brain-0.7 是一个 9B 视觉语言模型，通过结合空间定位、任务理解和进度估计，对长程具身任务进行可靠的执行基础推理。

papers.abstract: Real-time task guidance is inherently flexible: when an agent guides a user through a task, multiple responses and timings can be appropriate, and sometimes the best action is to remain silent. Existing benchmarks often miss this flexibility by treating synthesized dialogues as fixed targets for what to say and when to say it. We introduce FLUID (Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance), a unified framework for modeling, evaluating, and enabling flexible interaction in multimodal task guidance. Using naturally occurring human-human guidance from WTaG and HoloAssist, FLUID grounds interventions in their supporting evidence, necessity, and timing flexibility, and uses this representation both to evaluate flexible guidance and to build a real-time agent for task guidance. Our agent achieves the strongest overall balance of response correctness, intervention precision, timely guidance, and response latency among evaluated systems, while still leaving room for improvement in avoiding speech overlap. Together, FLUID moves situated task guidance beyond rigid reference matching toward more natural and adaptive human-AI interaction. Project page: https://fluid-guidance.github.io.

analysis.key_results: 该智能体在评估系统中实现了响应正确性、干预精确性、及时引导和响应延迟之间的最佳整体平衡，但在避免语音重叠方面仍有改进空间。
analysis.limitations: 在避免语音重叠方面仍有改进空间。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了 FLUID 框架，将情境任务引导从固定的参考匹配转向更自然、自适应的交互，并构建了一个实时的任务引导智能体。
analysis.method: 利用 WTaG 和 HoloAssist 中的人类-人类引导数据，将干预措施基于其支持证据、必要性和时间灵活性进行建模，并使用该表示来评估灵活引导和构建实时智能体。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: FLUID 是一个统一的框架，用于建模、评估和实现多模态情境任务引导中的灵活交互，通过利用人类-人类引导数据并基于证据、必要性和时间灵活性来构建实时引导智能体。

papers.abstract: Pretrained language models (LMs) remain unreliable on exact multi-digit arithmetic without gradient fine-tuning or external tool interpreters. We introduce closed-form, zero-gradient circuit-grafting primitives that compile deterministic computation directly into pretrained LM weights using zero training examples and zero runtime hooks, while bounding per-layer normalization drift and preserving natural-language (NL) competence. Our construction combines three analytical mechanisms: (1) two-layer Mellin-GLU quadrature over bias-free SwiGLU/GeGLU layers, turning unknown per-token RMSNorm scaling into translation along a log-spaced gate grid ($>250\times$ dynamic range) with IEEE 754 error bounds; (2) cross-token scale cancellation via signed Chebyshev Indefinite-RoPE self-sink attention and memoryless SiLU-antisymmetric GatedDeltaNet shifts; and (3) axis-aligned width extension ($d \to d+K$) with $\sqrt{d/(d+K)}$ norm compensation, Base-1000 canonical BPE emission, and differential $(+254,-256)$ tied unembeddings. An automated 5-stage compiler synthesizes 4-8 digit signed $\{+,-,\times\}$ circuits in constant $\mathsf{TC}^0$ depth alongside 3-literal Boolean (100%, $N=1{,}728$; plus 42-layer Gemma 4 E4B audits) and 5-bit Majority/Parity (100%) circuits. On 6-digit arithmetic ($N=1{,}200$, BF16), IBM Granite 4.2 3B (1.07M-1.33M active non-zeros, $\le 0.036\%$) and Alibaba Qwen 3.5 4B (2.25M-2.39M non-zeros, $\le 0.057\%$) reach 99.17% and 100.00% ALU-prefix accuracy (100% with an FP32 sidecar) and 98%-100% mid-sentence resumption, outperforming 12.8K-sample LoRA (42.2% / 61.7%, 0% inline continuation). A factorized block-sparse sidecar holds A100 memory at 7.89 / 10.65 GiB (4.60 / 8.14 GiB under INT8/INT4 + FP32 sidecar) while passing all 14/14 pre-registered $>2$K-token Tango splits ($N=4{,}392$; 0/11,134 OOD triggers).

analysis.key_results: 在6位算术上，Granite 3B和Qwen 4B分别达99.17%和100%的ALU前缀准确率；电路稀疏度极低（≤0.057%）；块稀疏sidecar显存占用7.89/10.65 GiB，INT8/INT4下4.60/8.14 GiB；14/14 Tango分片通过，无OOD触发。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入闭式、零梯度的电路移植原语，把确定性计算编译进预训练LM权重，实现多位数算术与布尔电路的高精度执行，同时保持自然语言能力。
analysis.method: 结合三层分析机制：基于Mellin-GLU的两层正交积分、跨token符号消除注意力/状态机、以及带范数补偿的宽度扩展，配合自动化5阶段编译器生成TC^0深度电路。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出零梯度电路移植原语，将确定性算术与布尔电路直接写入预训练语言模型权重，无需微调或运行时钩子。

papers.abstract: Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback. Yet existing benchmarks either evaluate reasoning and execution within the same tasks or assess them separately without their composition, so they reveal little about whether a failure comes from reasoning, execution, or their composition. We introduce Mind2Act World, a diagnostic benchmark of 30 simulated manipulation tasks from five real-world application domains. Each task has three difficulty levels and two scene settings (Clean and Random), yielding 180 configurations. The tasks form three views: Mind tests decisions based on past observations, Act tests precise and timely execution, and Mind2Act combines both in closed-loop tasks where action outcomes guide later decisions. Comparing the three views shows whether a system lacks a capability or fails to compose capabilities it already has. A diagnosis harness further attributes the failed episodes of three representative systems to Mind, Act, or their composition and summarizes each system in a profile card. Our evaluation of multimodal agents, vision-language-action models (VLAs), and world-action models (WAMs) shows that competence in a single view does not carry over to Mind2Act tasks. Even the strongest agent succeeds in 52.7% of Mind and 39.0% of Act episodes but in only 12.0% of Mind2Act episodes. The strongest agent retains task state but struggles with sustained contact, whereas end-to-end policies execute practiced motions but retain little task state. These findings point to composing reasoning and execution through environmental feedback as the main open problem.

analysis.key_results: 最强智能体在Mind视图成功率为52.7%，Act视图为39.0%，但Mind2Act视图仅为12.0%；最强智能体能保持任务状态但难以持续接触，而端到端策略能执行熟练动作但状态保持差。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了Mind2Act World基准，包含30个模拟操作任务（来自五个真实应用领域、三个难度级别、两种场景设置），以三个视图（Mind、Act、Mind2Act）诊断系统在推理、执行及其组合上的能力，并提供诊断工具将失败归因于Mind、Act或组合。
analysis.method: 构建了包含180种配置的模拟操作任务基准，通过对比三个视图的表现来诊断能力缺陷，并使用诊断工具分析三个代表性系统（多模态智能体、VLA、WAM）的失败原因。

papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) models enable efficient test-time adaptation by leveraging expert demonstrations as additional context without updating model parameters. However, even when retrieved demonstrations are relevant to the current task, the VLA may fail to effectively utilize the retrieved information, ultimately leading to task failure. To address this challenge, we propose R2-VLA, a risk-controlled retrieval-augmented VLA framework that enables reliable test-time adaptation by satisfying a user-specified task success rate requirement with minimal expert assistance. Specifically, R2-VLA learns an uncertainty predictor that estimates the uncertainty of the VLA's predicted actions given the retrieved demonstrations, guiding when to act autonomously or request expert assistance. We further introduce a task-level risk-control procedure that calibrates the uncertainty threshold to satisfy a user-specified task-failure risk requirement. Moreover, R2-VLA continually incorporates expert corrections into its retrieval memory to improve future adaptation while preserving the prescribed task-level risk guarantee. Experiments across three VLA backbones and four LIBERO benchmark suites demonstrate that R2-VLA improves average task success by 9.2--11.2 percentage points, achieving the desired target with fewer expert requests. These results highlight the effectiveness of connecting the usefulness of retrieved demonstrations with task-level risk control to enable successful robotic manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在三种VLA骨干和四个LIBERO基准套件上，R2-VLA将平均任务成功率提高9.2–11.2个百分点，同时以更少的专家请求达到目标成功率。

papers.abstract: Long-term agents accumulate large external memory stores as interactions unfold, increasing the costs of storage, retrieval, and response generation. Efficiency is constrained by two coupled factors: a growing record count increases retrieval overhead, while longer retrieved contexts increase prefill computation and decoding-time attention costs. Existing methods prune or consolidate records, but pruning can discard useful evidence, whereas consolidation may produce fewer yet longer retrieval units. We introduce MemFolder, a structure-guided memory folding framework that sequentially reduces record count and context length. The framework comprises two core components that share memory groups, using cross-record structure to guide both evidence consolidation and compact representation. RecordFolder grounds entity mentions, progressively selects representative yet complementary anchors, and combines semantic and entity affinity with temporal chaining to consolidate compatible records into fewer retrieval units. ContextFolder encodes the original records within these groups into compact text and uses verification feedback to revise encodings when key facts cannot be recovered. Experiments on the three text-based memory benchmarks LoCoMo, PersonaMem, and LongMemEval and the two multimodal benchmarks M3-Bench-web and M3-Bench-robot demonstrate the strong performance of our methods. Notably, on Mem0, RecordFolder retains 99.0% of the original average performance across the three text-based benchmarks with 50% fewer records, exceeding the strongest baseline by 1.9 percentage points in performance retention. Combined with ContextFolder, existing record compression methods further shorten their output records while retaining most of their performance.

analysis.key_results: 在LoCoMo、PersonaMem和LongMemEval三个文本基准上，RecordFolder减少50%记录时保留99.0%的平均性能，比最强基线高1.9个百分点；结合ContextFolder可进一步缩短输出记录长度并保留大部分性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出MemFolder结构引导记忆折叠框架，通过RecordFolder和ContextFolder协同减少记录数与上下文长度，在多个文本和多模态记忆基准上以更少存储开销保持性能。
analysis.method: RecordFolder基于实体提及和语义/实体亲和性及时间链选择代表性锚点以合并记录；ContextFolder将原始记录编码为紧凑文本，并通过验证反馈修正编码以确保关键事实可恢复。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: MemFolder通过结构引导的记忆折叠顺序减少记录数量和上下文长度，在文本和多模态记忆基准上保持性能的同时提升智能体记忆效率。

papers.abstract: A central goal of humanoid robotics is for robots to perform the everyday work people do in homes and workplaces. Existing egocentric video datasets cover many of these activities but provide little synchronized whole-body motion data for learning loco-manipulation at scale. We build Awaken-Human, which pairs approximately 50,000 hours of egocentric stereo video with synchronized whole-body human motion and covers more than 100 skills. Building on this, we also introduce Awaken-HI (Humanoid Intelligence), a vision-language-action model for humanoid loco-manipulation that jointly predicts original human motion and retargeted robot actions through a shared action expert. We show that loco-manipulation skills transfer more effectively from people to humanoids when human trajectories directly supervise the shared action expert. Increasing human pretraining data reduces held-out robot action prediction error according to an empirical scaling law and raises the mean success rate on downstream real-robot tasks. After full-corpus pretraining and T800 adaptation, Awaken-HI achieves a mean success rate of 93.75% across eight individual tasks and outperforms GR00T N1.7 and $\pi_{0.5}$ in both individual and long-horizon evaluations. The same policy generalizes to objects unseen during robot post-training and to new pairings of familiar objects and destinations.

analysis.key_results: 经过全语料库预训练和T800适应后，Awaken-HI在八项任务上平均成功率达到93.75%，在单项和长程评估中均优于GR00T N1.7和π0.5，并能泛化到机器人后训练未见过的物体和新配对。

papers.abstract: Representative vision-language navigation (VLN) methods typically couple a vision-language model (VLM) brain with a learnable action head and fine-tune the VLM brain on navigation-domain data to predict geometric goals. However, such adaptation can substantially alter base VLM weights and degrade general visual capabilities. We introduce ZeroVLN, a slow-fast navigation framework that achieves effective navigation with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain. Rather than teaching the brain to predict geometric goals, we equip it with a semantic tool-calling interface for conveying movement decisions to an action expert in natural language. We first adapt the action expert to carry out these movement requests, then jointly improve the brain's movement decisions and the action expert's continuous execution through closed-loop reinforcement learning (RL). Trained on the same navigation episodes, ZeroVLN substantially outperforms representative SFT-based hierarchical VLN methods on standard VLN-CE (continuous environments) benchmarks, while inducing only minor changes to the brain's weights and largely preserving its general capabilities. To our knowledge, ZeroVLN is the first slow-fast VLN framework with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain, and the first to jointly optimize its slow and fast policies through closed-loop agentic RL in VLN-CE.

analysis.key_results: 在标准VLN-CE基准上大幅超越代表性SFT分层VLN方法，同时仅对大脑权重产生轻微改变，基本保留其通用能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ZeroVLN框架，实现了零导航领域SFT的VLM大脑导航，并首次在VLN-CE中通过闭环智能体强化学习联合优化慢策略与快策略。
analysis.method: 采用慢-快导航架构，赋予VLM语义工具调用接口，将移动决策以自然语言传递给动作专家；先适配动作专家执行移动请求，再通过闭环强化学习联合改进大脑决策与动作专家执行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ZeroVLN提出慢-快导航框架，在不进行导航领域SFT的情况下，通过语义工具调用和闭环强化学习实现视觉语言导航。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently been equipped with tactile sensing to perceive visually subtle contact events in contact-rich manipulation. However, adding tactile input yields inconsistent gains, and some visuo-tactile VLA models rely little on tactile input, because much of the tactile change, such as the gel deformation during gripper closure, is predictable from visual observations and executed actions. To address this problem, we introduce TacInno, which isolates the contact dynamics that vision and executed actions cannot explain, termed tactile innovation, and uses tactile innovation only as a training target. Specifically, the TacInno tokenizer, conditioned on visual observations and executed actions, compresses the future tactile change into a discrete code, and the policy, TacInno-VLA, learns to predict the code, adding no module for the code at deployment. TacInno-VLA achieves average success rates of 87.5% across six simulation tasks and 70.5% across four real-world tasks, outperforming the strongest visuo-tactile baseline by 10.7 and 9.0 percentage points, respectively. Ablation studies validate the contributions of visual and action conditioning, multi-frame encoding, and auxiliary code prediction. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of tactile innovation as a supervision signal for contact-rich manipulation.

analysis.key_results: TacInno-VLA 在六个仿真任务中平均成功率 87.5%，在四个真实世界任务中平均成功率 70.5%，分别比最强视觉-触觉基线高出10.7和9.0个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TacInno，一种将“触觉创新”（视觉观察和已执行动作无法预测的触觉变化）作为唯一训练目标的框架，以提升VLA模型在接触丰富操作中的性能。

analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型，改进其在接触丰富操作中的机器人操作能力；通过明确建模视觉与动作之外的触觉动力学，为机器人世界建模中的接触动力学表征提供了新思路。

papers.abstract: Egocentric video captioning requires fine-grained detail and accurate timing, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often miss brief actions, confuse their order, or misinterpret the wearer's motion. Existing caption formats also offer limited support for combining detailed narration with precise timing. We present EgoCaptioner, which pairs a video-level overview of the setting, participants, and the wearer's overall activity with timed steps whose narration adapts to varying perceptual demands and marks key moments at specific timestamps. We develop a coarse-to-fine annotation pipeline that establishes event structure before expanding step descriptions, yielding 50,000 training examples from eight egocentric video sources. Complementary rewards assess factual accuracy and coverage, measure step-level temporal alignment, and penalize fragmented or redundant narration, guiding caption refinement through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). To improve the reliability of factual supervision, we supplement caption references with pose-derived motion facts when sensor data are available. Across five egocentric benchmarks, EgoCaptioner achieves leading performance among evaluated open-source models in caption quality, caption-conditioned question answering, and temporal alignment. It also surpasses Gemini 3.1 Pro on PhysCapBench and all evaluated proprietary baselines on Minerva-Ego under the caption-to-QA protocol. Ablations support the complementary roles of factual and temporal rewards and show that coarse-to-fine annotation provides more effective supervision than single-pass annotation.

analysis.key_results: 在五个自我中心基准上，在字幕质量、字幕条件问答和时间对齐方面领先开源模型；在PhysCapBench上超过Gemini 3.1 Pro，在Minerva-Ego的字幕到问答协议下超过所有专有基线；消融实验验证了事实和时间奖励的互补作用以及粗细结合标注的有效性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出EgoCaptioner方法，结合粗细结合标注流程与基于GRPO的奖励优化，生成全面细粒度、时间对齐的自我中心视频字幕。
analysis.method: 粗细结合标注流程，结合视频级概述与带时间戳的步骤级叙述；使用事实准确性、时间对齐、覆盖和流畅性奖励通过GRPO进行优化；在传感器数据可用时，利用姿态派生的运动事实增强事实监督。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种自我中心视频字幕生成方法，通过粗细结合的标注流程和奖励引导优化，提升字幕的细节与时间对齐能力。

papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) demonstrate broad generalization across tasks and domains. However, comparable generalization in robot manipulation remains challenging. Heterogeneity in robot embodiments, task formulations, geometric conventions, and action interfaces fragments interaction experience across benchmarks and hardware. We rethink robot skill learning through alignment: Can heterogeneous interactions across benchmarks and embodiments jointly improve one shared skillset for robot manipulation? We propose UniCraft, a framework for learning robot manipulation skills by aligning heterogeneous settings. Specifically, UniCraft represents observed scene geometry using consistent coordinate conventions and aligns sensing and control interfaces across robots. It organizes tasks from different benchmarks in a canonical format, allowing interaction feedback to jointly refine shared skills and the orchestration policy that guides their selection and composition, without any demonstrations or model weight updates. We interleave tasks from 3 benchmarks and 6 embodiments, collecting 2,700 learning rollouts per agent model. During training, UniCraft improves pooled task success on unseen scenarios and tasks by 9-28 percentage points on LIBERO-PRO, 10.8-13.3 on RoboTwin 2.0, and 3.1-14.4 on RoboCasa365 (Epochs 1-3). After training, with the learned skills frozen, UniCraft demonstrates zero-shot transfer across 4 new robot embodiments and 5 additional agent models on robosuite and RoboDojo.

analysis.key_results: 训练期间，在未见的场景和任务上，LIBERO-PRO提升9-28个百分点，RoboTwin 2.0提升10.8-13.3，RoboCasa365提升3.1-14.4（Epochs 1-3）。训练后冻结技能，在robosuite和RoboDojo上实现4个新机器人实施例和5个额外智能体模型的零样本迁移。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出UniCraft框架，通过对齐异构设置（几何坐标、传感与控制接口、任务格式）来学习可复用的机器人操作技能，并支持跨基准和实施例的联合提升。

papers.abstract: Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 501.3B total parameters and 23.4B active parameters, specifically built and optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads. Beam delivers frontier level reasoning, while requiring 3-4x less inference compute than many models of its class. Pretrained on 23.8T diverse, curated, high-quality tokens, Beam features a 1M-token context window achieved through a novel two-stage midtraining phase, built on verifiable, correctness-anchored data. Post-training leveraged a large-scale, fully asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) campaign across 10.5K GB300 GPUs, generating over 100M rollouts over 4 weeks of training. We believe this is one of the largest scale RL runs conducted by any open lab to date. Across our evaluation suite, capabilities continued to improve as we increased RL compute, with no sign of a plateau. Supported by deep hardware-model co-design, FP8/NVFP4 quantization, and a 1.93B-parameter speculative decoding drafter (DFlash 2), Beam maximizes serving throughput with efficient, flexible deployment. Averaged across conversation turns and harm categories, Beam refuses or pivots on 88.9% of harmful requests while complying with 81.5% of harmless requests, achieving the highest refusal/pivot rate on harmful requests among open-weight models on the Pareto frontier.

analysis.key_results: Beam在推理计算上比同类模型少3-4倍；在有害请求上拒绝或转向88.9%，无害请求合规81.5%；RL计算增加时能力持续提升，未见平台期。
analysis.main_contribution: 构建并优化了501.3B参数的稀疏MoE模型Beam，用于编码、推理和智能体工作负载，并集成推测解码和量化以实现高效推理。

papers.abstract: Large multimodal models can support long-horizon robot manipulation, but frequent model calls incur substantial latency and token costs. The central challenge is determining when agent assistance or intervention is needed and whether errors require correcting robot execution, subtask planning, or both. To address this problem, we propose RoC (Reasoning on Call), an efficient framework that coordinates a low-level policy and a high-level reasoning agent through an online task-state monitor. The monitor combines temporal visual observations with ordered interaction memory to jointly estimate progress within the active subtask and predict its successor. These predictions guide event-triggered agent review for coordinated execution repair and plan revision. Verified outcomes govern memory updates and subtask transitions, allowing routine execution to remain with the policy while reasoning focuses on decisions requiring additional assessment. On RMBench, RoC improves task success rate by 24.0 percentage points and reduces token consumption by 65.3% compared with the strongest agent-based baseline. It also outperforms the strongest policy-based baseline by 15.1 percentage points in task success rate. Real-world experiments further validate its effectiveness across three long-horizon manipulation tasks. Overall, RoC supports efficient agent intervention and coordinated recovery across execution and planning for long-horizon robot manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在RMBench上，相比最强智能体基线，任务成功率提升24.0个百分点，token消耗降低65.3%；相比最强策略基线，成功率提升15.1个百分点；在三个长时程操作任务的真实机器人实验中有效性得到验证。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出RoC（Reasoning on Call）框架，结合时序视觉观察与交互记忆，在线估计子任务进度并预测下一步子任务，实现事件触发的智能体审查与协同修正，显著提高任务成功率并大幅减少token成本。
analysis.method: 低层策略与高层推理智能体通过在线任务状态监控器协同；监控器联合时序视觉观察与有序交互记忆，预测活动子任务进度和后续子任务，触发智能体参与执行修复与计划修订；验证结果控制记忆更新与子任务切换。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出RoC框架，通过在线任务状态监控协调低层策略与高层推理智能体，在需要时触发智能体干预，以提升长时程机器人操作的成功率并降低token消耗。

papers.abstract: A one-pass decision encoder reads a text, a question and several named options, and returns a probability for each option in a single forward pass. We ask how far Laya, a 421M-parameter encoder of this kind, can be compressed before its decisions change. We count decisions that differ from Laya's own full-precision (fp32) answer, and track calibration (how well confidence matches accuracy, measured by expected calibration error, ECE), on 1,221 synthetic items with the training schemas, 273 with an unseen schema, and 800 out-of-family questions from ARC, MMLU and HellaSwag. Layer pruning of a related model family is known; we add flips, calibration, held-out data and retraining. bf16 changes 0.2% of in-family decisions but 2.2% out of family; 6-bit grouped rounding 1.3% and 5.9%; deleting 6 layers 0.9% and 9.1%, while ECE rises from 5.9% to 39.2%. One fitted temperature, needing no labels, restores it to 3.6%. One scale per tensor fails below six bits, and CPU dynamic int8 changes 30% of decisions, nearly all through one layer. Total variation tracks flips for rounding but not for deletion, and an early exit saves layers over a static cut only if its confidence gate is first recalibrated. Distilling a 16-layer student cuts its in-family flips from 44% to 9% (45% out of family). At equal stored size, rounding flips fewer decisions than deletion. Data are synthetic and LLM-labelled, for one architecture.

analysis.key_results: bf16改变0.2%的同族决策但2.2%非同族；6位分组舍入为1.3%和5.9%；删除6层为0.9%和9.1%，ECE从5.9%升到39.2%；一次拟合温度恢复为3.6%；每个张量一个尺度在低于6位失败；CPU动态int8改变30%的决策，几乎全部通过一层；总变差跟踪舍入的翻转但不跟踪删除；早退仅在重新校准置信门后节省层；蒸馏16层学生将同族翻转从44%削减到9%（非同族45%）；在相同存储大小下，舍入翻转的决策少于删除。
analysis.limitations: 数据是合成的且由LLM标注，仅针对一种架构。
analysis.main_contribution: 测量并比较了多种压缩策略（bf16、6位分组舍入、层剪枝、蒸馏、早退等）对决策变化和校准的影响，并发现温度校准可恢复剪枝后的校准。

papers.abstract: Video diffusion transformers reuse key--value (KV) caches across denoising steps, which quickly becomes a bottleneck for long video generation. We find that quantizing temporally distant cache vectors leads to a large range and high quantization error, but that nearby video tokens in the KV-cache share a persistent pattern per channel. These patterns also vary across videos, motivating rotations that are adapted to each video's unique cache. We propose Temporal Rotation Quantization (TRQ), a method that rotates frames in the cache that are adjacent in time before quantization. For each block of temporally adjacent cache vectors, TRQ fits an orthogonal transform that maps the block's per-channel means to a vector that is close to a constant across channels. To keep the quantization format lightweight, we parameterize this rotation as a tree of $2 \times 2$ planar rotations, each stored with only two bits, followed by a fixed Hadamard transform shared across all blocks. The rotations are fit without gradients or changes to model weights, and we prove that a simple greedy fit is globally optimal for our 'mean-flattening' objective. The transforms are fit online for each new video, and we release fused Triton kernels to make this process efficient at inference. At 2-bit precision and matched compression, TRQ improves VBench subject consistency over the state-of-the-art method QVG from 90.38 to 92.02 on LongCat-Video-13B and from 86.33 to 87.61 on HY-WorldPlay-8B, as well as improving other metrics.

analysis.key_results: 在2比特精度下，TRQ在LongCat-Video-13B上将VBench主体一致性从90.38提升至92.02，在HY-WorldPlay-8B上从86.33提升至87.61，并改善其他指标。

analysis.method: 对时域相邻的KV缓存块拟合正交旋转（参数化为2×2平面旋转树加Hadamard变换），使每通道均值接近常数（mean-flattening），然后进行2比特量化；旋转在线拟合，并使用Fused Triton内核加速。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出TRQ方法，针对视频扩散Transformer的KV缓存，通过在线拟合时域旋转来改善2比特量化的效果。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to perform diverse tasks from visual observations and language instructions. While prior work has explored task suppression and refusal, stopping prohibited behavior once execution is underway and controlling the resulting physical response remain challenging. Our evaluation reveals that policies which suppress a task from its initial state can still complete it when taking over partway through execution. Even when the task remains unfinished, the robot may drop a held object, making non-completion an incomplete measure of safety. To address these challenges, we introduce State-Aware Fallback Imitation (SAFI) for tasks where holding provides an appropriate alternative response. SAFI comprises two stages, (1) fallback target construction, which assigns stationary arm commands and consistent gripper targets throughout prohibited-task demonstrations, and (2) joint policy adaptation, which learns these targets alongside the original actions of retained tasks. This supervision teaches an explicit alternative response at intermediate execution states while maintaining the robot's other skills. Extensive experiments with OpenVLA-OFT across LIBERO and BadLIBERO tasks evaluate prohibited completion, physical incidents, and retained-task performance. On the evaluated LIBERO tasks, SAFI reduces aggregate target success after takeover to 1.3\%, with no recorded physical incidents or action saturation, while preserving high retained-task success.

papers.abstract: Humanoid agents in everyday environments are expected to react to diverse cues as humans do, with semantically appropriate and physically executable behaviors. Existing cue-driven reaction generation methods support only a narrow range of cue modalities and are limited to purely kinematic generation, leaving the resulting reactions susceptible to physical artifacts. To this end, we present MixReact, the first unified framework for physics-based reactive humanoid control from text, audio, and video cues, integrating a Discrete--Continuous Mixture of Transformers (DisCo-MoT) for state prediction with a History-aware Action Transformer (HAT) for physical execution. DisCo-MoT couples a discrete masked-modeling branch with a continuous autoregressive diffusion branch via one-way mixture attention within a MoT architecture. Guidance from discrete context mitigates collapse into averaged behaviors in one-to-many reaction generation, while direct prediction in continuous state space bypasses the decoding bottleneck of discrete representations. HAT then maps the predicted next state and observed execution history to executable actions, enabling robust closed-loop control in physics-based simulation. Experiments across all three modalities demonstrate consistent improvements over the baselines in fidelity, diversity, and physical consistency, while ablations validate the complementary contributions of the components. Our code will be released to facilitate future research. Project page: https://binlee26.github.io/MixReact_Page/

analysis.key_results: 在三种模态上的实验表明，MixReact在保真度、多样性和物理一致性方面一致优于基线，消融实验验证了各组件的互补贡献。

papers.abstract: Recently, video world models have advanced interactive generation, with large models offering higher quality and smaller models enabling faster inference. Existing speculative methods combine their strengths through fast draft generation and selective target regeneration guided by rewards on decoded frames. However, verification covers only the external scorer's evaluation dimensions and adds decoding and scoring costs. Moreover, these scores provide no correction, requiring costly target regeneration for rejected drafts. To address these limitations, we propose Speculative World Model (SpecWM), a unified, training-free inference framework for streaming world models. It verifies draft chunks using the target's latent velocity field. Verification also yields a reusable correction; two thresholds select Accept, Refine, or Reject. Specifically, one-step refinement reuses it to improve perceptual quality, while three-step refinement strengthens camera following and trajectory consistency. These findings motivate transition-aware refinement. On WBench Navigation, SpecWM improves visual quality at 1.63$\times$ speedup over the target and raises NavScore from the draft's 75.99 to 85.63, achieving the best quality-speed-control trade-off. Additionally, our LongSpecBench shows sustained quality and control over long, multi-turn rollouts, while experiments on Hy-Nomas validate SpecWM across backbones and denoising budgets.

analysis.key_results: 在 WBench Navigation 上，SpecWM 以 1.63 倍于目标的速度提升视觉质量，并将 NavScore 从草稿的 75.99 提高到 85.63；LongSpecBench 显示长期多轮 rollout 中质量和控制的持续性；Hy-Nomas 实验验证了跨骨干和去噪预算的适用性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 SpecWM，一种统一的免训练流式世界模型推理框架，通过目标潜速度场验证草稿块，并利用验证结果提供可复用的修正，实现接受、精炼或拒绝的三种决策。
analysis.method: 利用目标模型的潜速度场验证草稿块，验证同时产生可复用的修正；通过两个阈值选择接受、精炼或拒绝；一步精炼提升感知质量，三步精炼增强相机跟随与轨迹一致性，并引入过渡感知精炼。

papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can act as closed-loop robot-use agents (RUAs) by writing and executing control code through tool interfaces. However, turning an open-weight VLM into a high-performing embodied agent requires a complete post-training stack: out-of-the-box open VLMs fail completely at interactive tool contracts, strong frontier teachers are accessible only as black-box endpoints without exposed weights or token probabilities, and supervised imitation alone plateaus under rollout distribution shift. We present EmbodyAgent, an end-to-end post-training framework with three tightly coupled pipelines: (1) a black-box data synthesis pipeline that queries a strong teacher under a forced think-then-code contract and filters trajectories by task success; (2) an SFT pipeline that distills the explanation-and-program targets into an open-weight 9B VLM with both vision and language encoders trainable; and (3) an online RL pipeline that optimizes student-generated episodes via group-relative advantage with a runtime-error-penalized outcome reward. All three pipelines share one primitive-free Python execution tool exposing only raw visual observation and seven-dimensional end-effector control, with no action decoder and no interface shift across stages. Under a strictly separated evaluation protocol on ten LIBERO Spatial tasks (disjoint state splits, greedy test-time decoding, training-only safeguards), held-out success on 100 test states rises from 0/100 (base 9B VLM) to 14/100 (after SFT) and 84/100 (after RL), while training rollout success climbs from 8.4% to 87.7% and median model calls per episode drop from 36 to 11. We further identify a self-reinforcing runtime-error mode induced by outcome-based RL on executable code, and establish a failure-category monitoring and sampling-side curation protocol that stabilizes training.

analysis.key_results: 在10个LIBERO Spatial任务上，100个测试状态的成功率从0/100提升至SFT后的14/100和RL后的84/100；训练rollout成功率从8.4%升至87.7%，每次episode的中位模型调用次数从36降至11。
analysis.limitations: 识别出基于结果的RL在可执行代码上会诱导自强化运行时错误模式，需通过失败类别监控和采样侧策展协议来稳定训练。

papers.abstract: Multi-view vision-language-action (VLA) models still face challenges in spatial generalization, particularly under changes in camera viewpoints and robot initial states. These models typically receive action supervision only in the robot base frame, requiring them to implicitly learn the spatial correspondence between observations from each view and base-frame actions. We propose One View, One Action (OVOA-VLA), which learns to predict actions in each view's camera frame, allowing the same physical motion to provide diverse, observation-aligned supervision across views. OVOA-VLA jointly trains a base-frame expert and view-specific action experts, whose robot-state inputs and action targets are expressed in their respective camera frames. Two complementary directed attention graphs model both directions of interaction between the base and view-specific experts, jointly leveraging view-specific action supervision to improve base-frame prediction. Cross Graph Consistency further encourages agreement between the two graphs' base-frame predictions for the same sample. With the same multi-view inputs, the model supports both full and base-only inference. Experiments across multiple simulation benchmarks demonstrate improved manipulation performance and robustness to camera-viewpoint and robot-initialization perturbations. Full and base-only inference achieve average success rates of 88.1% and 85.7% on LIBERO-Plus, respectively. In real-world evaluations, base-only inference raises the average success rates from $\pi_{0.5}$'s 28.3% to 58.3% across three tasks under spatial distribution shifts.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO-Plus仿真基准上，全推理和仅基座推理的平均成功率分别为88.1%和85.7%；真实世界评估中，仅基座推理将三个空间分布偏移任务的平均成功率从π0.5的28.3%提高到58.3%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出OVOA-VLA框架，通过观察对齐专家和跨图一致性，使VLA模型能够以多视角相机坐标系进行动作预测，从而提高空间泛化性。
analysis.method: 联合训练基座帧专家和视角特定动作专家，使用两个互补的有向注意力图建模基座帧与视角专家间的双向交互，并通过交叉图一致性正则化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出OVOA-VLA，通过在多相机视角下以每个视角的相机坐标系预测动作，并利用跨图一致性训练，提升视觉-语言-动作模型对相机视角和机器人初始状态变化的空间泛化能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接聚焦于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的空间泛化能力，提出观察对齐的专家框架和跨图一致性方法，显著提升了机器人在不同视角和初始状态下的操作性能，并展示了从仿真到真实环境的迁移能力，与VLA主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Long-horizon agentic tasks require a model to call tools over many steps at contexts of 100K tokens or more, yet many low-bit quantization methods are calibrated on short web text and judged on perplexity. This mismatch is costly: existing quantizations of Qwen3.8-27B at or below 3 bits per weight match BF16 on shorter tasks like AIME, yet in published results solve at most 72% as many tasks as BF16 on DeepSWE, a long-horizon agentic benchmark. We propose NariQ, a trellis-coded post-training quantization method that calibrates on tokens generated by the BF16 model in agent sessions. On Qwen3.8-27B, NariQ at 3.0 and 2.5 bits per weight stays level with BF16 on two long-horizon agentic benchmarks, DeepSWE and Terminal Bench, as well as on AIME and RealWorldQA. Our checkpoint at 2.0 bits per weight trails this performance. To our knowledge, these are the first quantizations at or below 3 bits per weight shown to match their full-precision version on long-horizon agentic tasks. We release the files as Qwen3.8-27B-NariQ-GGUF (https://huggingface.co/nari-labs/Qwen3.8-27B-NariQ-GGUF), with inference available through our llama.cpp fork at https://github.com/nari-labs/nari-llama.cpp.

analysis.key_results: Qwen3.8-27B在3.0和2.5 bits per weight下与BF16在DeepSWE、Terminal Bench、AIME和RealWorldQA上表现持平；2.0 bits版本性能有所落后。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出NariQ，一种针对长时程智能体任务校准的trellis编码后训练量化方法，首次使3 bit及以下量化模型在长时程agentic benchmarks上与全精度版本性能相当。
analysis.method: Trellis编码后训练量化，校准数据来自BF16模型在智能体会话中生成的token。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 一种通过在智能体会话中生成的token上进行校准的trellis编码后训练量化方法NariQ，使3 bit及以下量化模型在长时程智能体任务上与BF16持平。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于模型量化方法在长时程agentic任务上的应用，未直接涉及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型或世界模型（WAM），但所提方法对在资源受限环境中部署机器人VLA/WAM模型可能具有借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: Reasoning models provide strong multimodal task understanding but struggle with sub-second control because deliberation increases decision latency. Fast decision models can meet the response window, yet prompting and few-shot examples do not readily provide the fine-grained experience required by a new task. Inspired by coached motor learning, this paper presents System-One Recursive Self-Improvement (System-One RSI), which couples two loops. The high-frequency online inner loop is an Observe, Orient, Decide, Act (OODA) cycle: a decision model maps each visual observation and task question to structured judgments, and a decision tree converts them into timed actions without invoking a reasoning model. The offline outer loop is a recursive improvement cycle carried out by a team of reasoning agents. The team revises the decision-model prompt and decision tree, captures interaction records, derives supervision from those records, and trains or deploys updated model parameters. The improved system then returns to the environment and generates the experience for the next round, consolidating learned distinctions as external muscle memory. The framework operates with a small number of real episodes, without expert demonstrations, environment modification, sandboxing, or parallel simulation. Experiments in Snake, Zenless Zone Zero, and Black Myth: Wukong use a 27B decision model. Mean Snake score increases from 1.30 to 7.35. In an evaluated scenario of Zenless Zone Zero, median completion time decreases by 8.4%. In an evaluated combat scenario of Black Myth: Wukong, the evasive policy achieves 11 times the mean survival time of a stationary reference, while the offensive policy win rate rises from 0% to 66.7% across the evaluated configurations.

analysis.key_results: 在Snake中平均得分从1.30提升到7.35；在Zenless Zone Zero的评估场景中，中位完成时间减少8.4%；在Black Myth: Wukong的评估战斗场景中，闪避策略的平均存活时间达到静止参考的11倍，进攻策略胜率从0%提升至66.7%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出System-One RSI，一个结合在线OODA决策循环与离线递归自我改进的双循环框架，使决策模型能够在少量真实回合、无专家演示或环境修改的情况下持续提升交互任务表现。
analysis.method: 高频在线内循环使用OODA（观察-定向-决策-行动）周期，由决策模型将视觉观察和任务问题映射为结构化判断，决策树将其转换为定时动作；离线外循环由一组推理智能体修订决策模型提示和决策树，并从交互记录中提取监督信号来训练或部署更新的模型参数。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出System-One RSI框架，通过高频OODA决策循环和离线递归自我改进，使决策模型无需推理模型即可实现亚秒级控制并逐步提升任务表现。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作主要关注通过决策模型与决策树实现高效推理和亚秒级控制，未直接涉及VLA或WAM，但其低延迟决策和递归改进方法对机器人实时控制策略具有潜在参考价值。

papers.abstract: Continual reinforcement learning (CRL) requires models to acquire new capabilities while retaining performance on previous tasks. A stability-oriented perspective common in conventional continual learning emphasizes knowledge preservation and interference mitigation. Complementing this perspective, we revisit CRL for vision-language models through policy improvement, a fundamental principle of RL, to preserve acquired performance gains. Using the performance difference lemma, we characterize historical performance changes through the current policy's expected advantages on historical task distributions, motivating replay of historical prompts with the current policy. To allocate limited replay memory, we propose Contrastive Likelihood Replay (CoLiR), which contrasts likelihood gains on correct responses from the final task policy with likelihood reductions on incorrect responses from the initial policy. Our analysis links correct-response likelihood gains to reference-policy advantages under an idealized KL-regularized optimal update and provides an endogenous-reward interpretation for general policy updates. CoLiR estimates scores from finite training rollouts and cached log-likelihoods, selects prompts at task boundaries, and replays them uniformly during subsequent training, with KL regularization restricted to replayed prompts. Memory construction only requires a small amount of additional cross-policy scoring but no additional response generation. Across three Qwen3-VL model sizes on MRCL, CoLiR achieves the highest mean final accuracy and mean task accuracy among the compared methods while maintaining competitive new-task performance.

analysis.key_results: 在三个不同规模的Qwen3-VL模型上，CoLiR在MRCL基准上取得了最高的平均最终准确率和平均任务准确率，同时保持了具有竞争力的新任务性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了Contrastive Likelihood Replay (CoLiR) 方法，利用策略改进视角选择回放提示，以在持续强化学习（CRL）中保持历史任务性能。
analysis.method: 使用性能差异引理刻画历史性能变化，通过对比最终任务策略在正确响应上的似然增益与初始策略在错误响应上的似然降低来选择回放提示，并在后续训练中均匀回放，仅在回放提示上应用KL正则化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了一种面向持续强化学习的策略改进引导回放方法CoLiR，通过对比正确响应的似然增益与错误响应的似然降低来选择回放样本。

papers.abstract: World models aim to predict environment dynamics under actions, enabling the prediction of action consequences without executing them in the real world. Yet despite producing increasingly realistic videos, current world models often fail to capture how small action changes affect future observations. This limits their use in tasks such as robotic policy evaluation and model-based planning, where nearly identical actions can lead to qualitatively different outcomes. To address this, we propose AFFECT, an auxiliary training objective for learning the distribution of visual changes induced by action perturbations. Specifically, we inject temporally correlated noise into the actions of a policy trained on task-agnostic human teleoperation. We then train the world model so that its generated videos respond to this noise as the recorded videos do, without requiring repeated executions from the same initial state. Across OGBench simulation and real-world DROID and ALOHA-2 setups, AFFECT makes world-model rollouts more faithful to real outcomes. On DROID, the Pearson correlation between policy success rates in the world model and on the real robot rises from 0.47 to 0.79, alongside up to 23% lower FVD. These gains carry over to planning, where selecting actions with AFFECT-trained world models improves task success by up to 8.3%.

analysis.key_results: 在DROID上，世界模型中的策略成功率与真实机器人上的Pearson相关系数从0.47提升至0.79，FVD降低最高23%；在规划任务中，使用AFFECT训练的世界模型选择动作可使任务成功率提高最多8.3%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出AFFECT辅助训练目标，通过注入时间相关噪声到动作中，并训练世界模型使生成视频对该噪声的响应与真实记录一致，以提升世界模型对动作效果建模的保真度。
analysis.method: 向任务无关人类遥操作策略的动作中注入时间相关噪声，将动作扰动引起的视觉变化分布作为辅助训练目标，训练世界模型使其生成视频对噪声的响应与真实视频一致。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出AFFECT，一个辅助训练目标，使世界模型生成视频能更真实地反映动作微小变化对未来的影响。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接聚焦于提升世界模型对动作效果的动力学保真度，对机器人策略评估和基于模型的规划具有重要价值，是VLA/WAM中世界模型相关研究的核心问题。

papers.abstract: Robotic world models predict future video frames from the current observation and a sequence of robot actions. While recent models follow the given actions closely, manipulated objects often collapse or move inconsistently with the action. We attribute this to the conditioning: an action, or a rendering of the robot, specifies where the robot goes but not how the scene responds, leaving a single video model to infer the interaction dynamics implicitly while also rendering appearance. We therefore separate dynamics prediction from visual rendering, with 3D point dynamics as the proxy between them. Specifically, we lift the first frame into 3D points, simulate how they respond to the robot's motion with a learned point dynamics model, and render the simulated points back into pixel-aligned videos that any video model can read. In controlled experiments on the DROID dataset with two video renderers of different architectures, this point dynamics proxy reduces object motion error by 8.6% and 6.2% without degrading image quality, and by 8.1% on a real bimanual robot. Moreover, the video follows the simulation: more accurate dynamics yield more accurate object motion, and editing the points steers the video. This suggests that advances in dynamics modeling can translate into more faithful robotic world models.

analysis.key_results: 在DROID数据集上的受控实验表明，与两种不同架构的视频渲染器结合时，点动力学代理分别将物体运动误差降低了8.6%和6.2%，且在真实双臂机器人上降低了8.1%，同时图像质量没有下降；更精确的动力学可产生更精确的物体运动，编辑点可引导视频生成。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出将动力学预测与视觉渲染分离，以3D点动力学作为中间代理，使视频生成中的物体运动更符合动作语义，提高机器人世界模型的保真度。
analysis.method: 将首帧图像提升到3D点，用学习到的点动力学模型模拟这些点对机器人运动的响应，然后将模拟后的点渲染回像素对齐的视频，供任何视频模型使用。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出将机器人世界模型中的动力学预测与视觉渲染分离，以3D点动力学作为代理来模拟物体响应，从而提升视频生成中物体运动的一致性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对机器人世界模型（WAM）进行研究，核心贡献在于通过点动力学代理提高视频生成中物体运动的物理一致性和动作遵循性，对WAM的发展具有重要指导意义。

papers.abstract: Latent world models predict the outcomes of action sequences, but comparing candidate plans through recursive rollout remains expensive at test time. We introduce Fast-JEPA, a latent world model planning framework that advances the success-latency Pareto frontier of predictive search. Fast-JEPA reorganizes predictive computation to support effective action-sequence search at low planning cost. It constructs a goal-directed plan to guide search and directly predicts the outcomes of complete candidates for efficient comparison, avoiding recursive state rollout during refinement. Across PushT, Reacher, Cube, and TwoRoom, Fast-JEPA achieves 96.50% average success rate with 2.41x faster planning than INTACT. Search-budget sweeps show that its competitive success and low latency extend across candidate counts and refinement depths. We further introduce DynaGoal, a benchmark for evaluating world-model planning under dynamic out-of-distribution conditions, execution deadlines, and controlled response delays. Fast-JEPA achieves average success rates of 73.83% on DynaGoal-Shift and 87.67% on DynaGoal-Deadline, demonstrating the practical value of low-latency predictive planning under changing control conditions and execution-time constraints. Our code is available at https://github.com/Sofilyzia/Fast-JEPA.

analysis.key_results: 在 PushT、Reacher、Cube 和 TwoRoom 上平均成功率达到 96.50%，规划速度比 INTACT 快 2.41 倍；在 DynaGoal-Shift 上平均成功率为 73.83%，在 DynaGoal-Deadline 上为 87.67%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Fast-JEPA 潜在世界模型规划框架，该框架在维持高成功率的同时显著降低规划延迟，并通过 DynaGoal 基准验证了其在动态分布外条件和执行时间约束下的实用性。
analysis.method: 构建目标导向计划来引导搜索，并直接预测完整候选序列的结果以进行高效比较，从而避免细化过程中的递归状态展开。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Fast-JEPA 提出一种低延迟潜在世界模型规划框架，通过目标导向搜索和直接预测完整候选结果，在多个机器人控制任务上以更快规划速度取得高成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接属于世界模型（WAM）范畴，针对机器人动作序列规划提出低延迟预测方法，并引入动态条件下的基准，对 VLA 系统中的高效规划与机器人世界模型研究具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Although memory-augmented architectures have expanded the ability of large vision-language models (LVLMs) to process long videos, existing retrieval processes still largely rely on global semantic matching and lack state-driven temporal control, often returning fragmented or redundant evidence and failing to maintain a coherent evidence chain. To address this challenge, we propose EvoMem, a time-aware long-video memory agent guided by self-evolving retrieval skills. EvoMem constructs a hierarchical time-indexed memory, where different types of evidence are aligned onto a unified video timeline; during retrieval, temporal cues from acquired evidence are further converted into explicit signals that constrain subsequent memory access. To address recurring procedural errors in long-video question answering, such as unclear retrieval targets, improper memory access paths, or premature stopping, EvoMem introduces retrieval skills to provide process-level guidance, enabling the agent to dynamically adjust retrieval content, memory operations, and target temporal ranges according to the current evidence state, while deciding when to stop. Furthermore, inspired by reinforcement learning, we formulate skill evolution as a reward-guided policy improvement process. Each candidate skill is treated as an external policy patch, and rewards are assigned according to answer-correctness state transitions on the validation set. In this way, effective skills are accepted and low-quality skills are rejected without updating model parameters. Experiments on four long-video question answering benchmarks show that EvoMem significantly outperforms existing baselines, achieving an average accuracy of 60.1% and an average improvement of 8.6 percentage points over the previous best methods, demonstrating its effectiveness for long-video reasoning.

analysis.key_results: 在四个长视频问答基准上平均准确率达到60.1%，比之前最佳方法平均提升8.6个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出EvoMem，一种由自进化检索技能引导的时间感知长视频记忆智能体，以解决长视频问答中检索碎片化和缺乏时间控制的问题。
analysis.method: 构建层次化时间索引记忆，将不同类型的证据对齐到统一时间线；利用时间线索约束后续记忆访问；引入检索技能提供过程级指导，并基于奖励引导的策略改进过程实现技能进化，不更新模型参数。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出EvoMem，一种基于自进化检索技能的时间感知长视频记忆智能体，通过层次化时间索引记忆和奖励引导的技能进化提升长视频问答表现。

papers.abstract: Recalling where and when an object was last seen and who saw it requires recognizing it across days and people. Existing long-video benchmarks focus on events, object categories, or relative locations, leaving instance-level spatial memory largely untested in multimodal models. To address this gap, we present EgoWitness, a benchmark for instance-level spatial memory and reasoning in egocentric video. Its 8,453 human-verified questions span approximately 324 hours of week-long and short-horizon recordings and test seven abilities, from recognizing an object or room to recalling who saw it and reasoning about room visits. Over one million reviewed masks of 34 registered landmarks and 21 movable-object labels are linked through room timelines. Among twelve direct vision-language models (VLMs), open-weight models reach at most 46.97% accuracy, and none exceeds 35% on identifying who saw an object last. We therefore propose EgoClue, a spatial-memory agent that retrieves candidate intervals, verifies instance identity, and computes spatial and temporal relations with five tools. Two-stage training with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) raises its 4B controller from 23.64% to 72.65% accuracy on 1,320 held-out questions. Evidence-trace synthesis matches the best direct VLM at 74.85% on week-long questions and achieves 80.56% in environments excluded from training.

analysis.key_results: 开放权重视觉语言模型最高准确率46.97%，且无人超过35%在识别谁最后看到物体的任务上；EgoClue在1,320个留出问题上从23.64%提升至72.65%，证据迹合成在周级问题上达74.85%，在未参与训练的环境达80.56%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出EgoWitness基准（8,453个问题，约324小时视频）和EgoClue空间记忆智能体（两阶段训练，精度提升至72.65%），填补实例级空间记忆评估空白。
analysis.method: EgoWitness包含34个地标和21个可移动物体标签，七种能力测试；EgoClue通过检索候选区间、验证实例身份、计算时空关系，并使用SFT和GRPO训练。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding has emerged as a critical technique for accelerating Large Language Model (LLM) inference by decoupling generation into a drafting phase and a parallel verification phase. A crucial challenge is therefore designing a drafter that is both lightweight and accurate enough to approximate the predictions of the target model. We present a highly optimized Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) architecture that extends existing backbone LLMs to efficiently produce high-quality drafts. Built around a single shared drafting head, our approach features three core architectural optimizations: target activation injection to anchor semantic planning, zero-copy KV-cache cross-attention to bypass prefill compute and reduce memory overhead, and an efficient clustered vocabulary projection to reduce the cost of full-vocabulary decoding. Testing these improvements with the Gemma 4 model family, our G-MTP shows out-of-the-box speedups for both large server-side setups (up to 3.1$\times$) and smaller models targeting memory-constrained on-device environments (up to 2.3$\times$ on H100 and up to 2.2$\times$ on a smartphone GPU). In addition, we present parameter-efficient fine-tuning recipes for G-MTP that keep the drafter aligned with the backbone LLM under domain shift, requiring up to 1.83$\times$ fewer target forward passes than tuning only the backbone.

analysis.key_results: 在大型服务器端设置中实现最高3.1倍加速，在内存受限设备上实现最高2.3倍加速（H100）和2.2倍加速（智能手机GPU）；参数高效微调方案在域偏移下保持草稿模型对齐，所需目标前向传递次数最多减少1.83倍。

analysis.method: 基于单一共享草稿头的多令牌预测架构，包含目标激活注入、零拷贝KV缓存交叉注意力和聚类词汇投影三项优化。

papers.abstract: 3D visual grounding (3D-VG) is a task that bridges the natural language and 3D space, serving as a foundational capability for embodied intelligence and human-computer interaction. Although recent 3D-VG agents overcome the reliance on pre-processed 3D point clouds, they essentially employ a unidirectional, pipeline-style tool-calling architecture. This architecture separates semantic understanding from geometric reconstruction, leading to error accumulation and an inability to autonomously recover from failures. To address this flaw, this paper proposes the Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent (DACA), which reinterprets 3D-VG as a semantic-geometric dual-anchor collaborative reasoning paradigm. DACA comprises two complementary specialized tools: the semantic anchor tool holds the visual semantic features of the target and achieves efficient target tracking via optical flow and VLM local verification; the geometric anchor tool holds the 3D spatial geometric features of the target and performs global spatial reasoning via voxelization and multi-keypoint projection. The two components exchange information bidirectionally via a standardized tool call protocol, autonomously deciding on the next perception-action step to form a closed-loop optimization. Experiments on the ScanRefer and Nr3D benchmarks demonstrate that zero-shot DACA achieves an overall Acc@0.25 of 73.6\% on ScanRefer and 70.4\% overall accuracy on Nr3D, far surpassing the latest zero-shot 3D-VG methods. The code and models are available at https://github.com/liujia99/DACA

analysis.key_results: 在ScanRefer和Nr3D基准上，零样本DACA分别达到73.6%的Acc@0.25和70.4%的整体准确率，远超最新的零样本3D视觉定位方法。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出双锚点协作智能体（DACA），将3D视觉定位重新定义为语义-几何双锚点协作推理，通过双向信息交换和自主感知-动作闭环优化，克服了传统管线式方法的错误累积和无法自主恢复的问题。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: DACA通过双锚点协作范式，将语义理解与几何重建统一为闭环迭代过程，实现零样本3D视觉定位。

papers.abstract: In recent years, GPUs have incorporated increasingly specialized support for low-precision computation, from Hopper's FP8 to Blackwell's FP4 Tensor Cores. Precision formats have evolved alongside this hardware, from MXFP4 and NVFP4 on Blackwell to E2M1 FP4 with direct UE5M3 block scaling on Vera Rubin, which we term as $\boldsymbol{VRFP4}$. These advances help serve larger language models at lower cost, but four-bit activation quantization can substantially degrade model quality. We introduce VR-SparseQuant, which uses Vera Rubin's elementwise 2:4 sparsity to recover accuracy while retaining native FP4 execution. By allowing two sparse streams to overlap, we use the same FP4 value budget as dense quantization to refine activations with larger errors. Offline scale-ratio calibration avoids runtime search, while a shared-weight GEMM accumulates both streams efficiently. On Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B, VR-SparseQuant reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from $\boldsymbol{6.85}$ to $\boldsymbol{5.57}$ versus dense RTN W4A4. Including activation preparation, our native Rubin kernels for VRFP4 achieve up to $\boldsymbol{3.1\times}$ GEMM and $\boldsymbol{2.7\times}$ MoE speedup over BF16. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study of adaptive activation quantization using Vera Rubin's elementwise 2:4 structured sparse FP4 instructions.

analysis.key_results: 在Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B上，相比密集RTN W4A4，WikiText-2困惑度从6.85降至5.57；包括激活准备后，VRFP4原生内核相比BF16实现最高3.1倍GEMM和2.7倍MoE加速。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入VR-SparseQuant，将元素级2:4稀疏性与FP4量化结合，利用相同的FP4数值预算增强高误差激活，实现精度恢复。
analysis.method: 利用Vera Rubin的元素级2:4稀疏性，允许两个稀疏流重叠，使用离线缩放比例校准避免运行时搜索，共享权重GEMM高效累加两个流，并在Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B上验证。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出VR-SparseQuant，利用Vera Rubin的2:4结构化稀疏FP4指令在保持FP4原生执行的同时恢复量化精度。

papers.abstract: We enable accurate low-bit recovery from small synthetic pools by improving both image synthesis and student preparation. A grid with lower local response error can incur greater error in the student's block context. Functional Grid Calibration (FGC) selects activation scales and integer offsets against full-precision responses constructed from the student's current block input. With weights fixed during calibration, FGC evaluates candidates only at their consuming operators, bringing block context to calibration at nearly local-scoring cost. For DeiT and ViT, progressive inversion updates the same images through increasingly deep teacher prefixes. With 1,000 images, the complete pipeline exceeds MimiQ's reported accuracy in all 18 W4A4/W5A5 settings across nine backbones. With 256 images, DeiT-S and ViT-S reach 68.20% and 66.90% ImageNet top-1 accuracy at W4A4 in 26-27 minutes on one RTX 5090. The pipeline outperforms strengthened 1K-image MimiQ by 13.03 and 24.36 percentage points at lower preparation cost and the same recovery-update count. The same low-budget checkpoints retain their advantage on ImageNetV2.

analysis.key_results: 使用1000张合成图像，完整流程在9个骨干网络的18个W4A4/W5A5设置中全部超过MimiQ的报告精度；使用256张图像，DeiT-S和ViT-S在W4A4下分别达到68.20%和66.90%的ImageNet top-1精度，在单张RTX 5090上耗时26-27分钟；相比强化的1000图像MimiQ，分别提升13.03和24.36个百分点，且准备成本更低，恢复更新次数相同。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出功能网格校准（FGC），利用学生当前块输入构造的全精度响应来校准激活尺度和整数偏移，使得校准过程包含块上下文，同时保持接近局部评分的成本；并结合渐进反演进一步提升合成图像质量。
analysis.method: 功能网格校准（FGC）在权重量化期间固定权重，仅评估候选激活尺度和偏移在消费算子上的效果，从而将块上下文带入校准；渐进反演通过逐渐加深的教师前缀更新合成图像。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies rely on visual feedback throughout manipulation, making them vulnerable to persistent texture attacks. However, optimized patterns can stand out from their surroundings, making an attack easier to notice and its carrier more likely to be inspected or removed. To address this limitation, our key insight is to search the structured image distribution of a diffusion model for natural-looking textures while using closed-loop feedback to identify task-disruptive candidates. Based on this idea, we propose DMT-Attack, a gradient-free gray-box attack that generates textures for ordinary scene objects such as tablecloths. A frozen text-conditioned diffusion model defines the search space, and an eight-expert latent proposal network is initialized from evaluated teacher latents and refined using rollout feedback. We evaluate DMT-Attack against pi_0.5 and OpenVLA-OFT across four LIBERO suites. DMT-Attack achieves a macro clean-conditioned attack success rate (cASR) of 57.9%, compared with 44.7% for UPA-RFAS and 19.7% for random natural textures. It also attains higher scene similarity and a lower clean-calibrated detector flag rate (45% versus 97.5-100% for optimized patch baselines). These results demonstrate that natural-looking textures can disrupt VLA visual feedback and closed-loop decision-making, motivating defenses that jointly assess visual appearance and task behavior.

analysis.key_results: 在四个LIBERO套件上对pi_0.5和OpenVLA-OFT进行评估，宏观干净条件攻击成功率(cASR)达57.9%，显著高于UPA-RFAS的44.7%和随机自然纹理的19.7%；场景相似度更高，清洁校准检测器误报率降至45%（优化补丁基线为97.5-100%）。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种灰盒攻击方法DMT-Attack，利用扩散模型生成自然纹理以干扰VLA策略的闭环视觉反馈，揭示外观自然但对任务破坏性强的对抗样本风险。

papers.abstract: Early interactions can reveal physical properties that later observations no longer show. These properties can still gov- ern the effects of future actions. Inspired by the distinction between retention and selective readout in working mem- ory and cognitive science, we introduce LATER, an action- conditioned world model built on CF-JEPA. LATER stores completed real transitions in partitioned memories that remain fixed during candidate rollouts. A response bridge queries these memories using the current state and candidate action, while multi-cut auxiliary supervision trains the memory writ- ers. On distracted Two-Stage PushT, LATER raises terminal success from 15.5% to 25.0% over reconstructed CF-JEPA. In a separate comparison across six models and two scratch- training seeds, LATER achieves the lowest mean physical readout error in both clean and distracted views, reducing along-push mean absolute error (MAE) under distractors by 20.2% relative to CF-JEPA. Controlled history interventions show that later predictions depend on earlier physical evi- dence even when query observations and actions are fixed, with larger effects during pushing than waiting.

analysis.key_results: 在 distracted Two-Stage PushT 上终局成功从15.5%提升到25.0%；六模型对比中在干净和干扰视图下取得最低平均物理读出误差，干扰下沿推平均绝对误差相对CF-JEPA降低20.2%；历史干预显示后期预测依赖于早期物理证据。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入LATER动作条件世界模型，通过分区记忆和响应桥从早期历史中检索物理证据，提高干扰下的预测精度。
analysis.method: 基于CF-JEPA构建，将真实转移存储于固定分区记忆中，通过响应桥用当前状态和动作查询记忆，并采用多截辅助监督训练记忆写入器。

papers.abstract: Efficient chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs) requires reducing both intermediate reasoning steps and their execution cost. Latent CoT methods compress textual rationales into continuous thoughts, yet their full-precision (FP) models retain substantial storage and computation costs. Lowering numerical precision could reduce these remaining costs, yet direct quantization severely degrades reasoning accuracy, particularly with 4-bit weights and activations. Operator and perturbation analyses reveal key sensitivity and direction-dependent predictive effects of continuous-thought errors, motivating preservation of information retrieval and subsequent reasoning beyond reconstruction accuracy. We therefore introduce QL-VLM, a dynamics-aware Quantization framework for efficient Latent reasoning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs). First, Dynamics-Guided Quantization (DGQ) uses nonuniform codebooks that preserve rotary-key structure, mitigating quantization-induced distortion in vision-language information retrieval. Second, Dynamics-Preserving Distillation (DPD) aligns continuous thoughts, latent-query readouts, and predictions with a full-precision teacher, maintaining predictive consistency through subsequent low-precision reasoning. On ScienceQA-IMG with Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct, 4-bit QL-VLM achieves 90.43% accuracy and improves baseline by 40.33%, with 16.64x fewer bit-operations and 6.40x lower measured latency than explicit CoT.

analysis.key_results: 在ScienceQA-IMG上，4位QL-VLM达到90.43%准确率，比基线提高40.33%，位操作减少16.64倍，显式CoT延迟降低6.40倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出QL-VLM框架，结合动力学引导量化（DGQ）和动力学保持蒸馏（DPD），在保持推理准确性的同时大幅降低视觉语言模型潜在推理的计算成本。
analysis.method: 动力学引导量化使用非均匀码本保留旋转键结构，动力学保持蒸馏将连续思维、潜在查询读数和预测与全精度教师对齐。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出QL-VLM框架，通过动力学引导量化和动力学保持蒸馏，在4位精度下实现视觉语言模型的高效潜在思维链推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该方法针对视觉语言模型的高效推理，未直接涉及机器人动作预测或世界模型，但量化技术对高效部署VLA模型具有潜在参考价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies must react while visual inference is still running. Overlapping computation and execution reduces waiting, yet leaves perceptual memory stale and successive action chunks disconnected. We present CauSyncVLA, an asynchronous dual-system controller that aligns perceptual-memory prediction and trajectory correction with actual robot execution. Rather than forecasting pixels or physical states, a Causal Latent World Model predicts current perceptual memory from delayed visual anchors and executed state-action history, supervised through action-sensitive distillation to retain the frozen expert's control response. Conditioned on this updated memory, Predictive Flow Warm-Starting (PFWS) aligns the unexecuted action horizon for single-step flow correction without extra training. On LIBERO-10, CauSyncVLA reaches 93.8% success at 5.04$\times$ inference throughput, improving closed-loop robustness and robot motion smoothness.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO-10上，CauSyncVLA达到93.8%的成功率，同时实现5.04×的推理吞吐，提高了闭环鲁棒性和机器人运动平滑性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出因果潜在世界模型，通过预测当前感知记忆（而非像素或物理状态）来增强异步视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，并配合预测流热启动实现无额外训练的动作轨迹校正。
analysis.method: 构建因果潜在世界模型，根据延迟视觉锚点和已执行的状态-动作历史预测当前感知记忆，并通过动作敏感蒸馏保留冻结专家策略的控制响应；在此基础上利用预测流热启动对未执行的动作序列进行单步校正。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出CauSyncVLA，一种异步双系统控制器，利用因果潜在世界模型对齐感知记忆与轨迹校正，在LIBERO-10上显著提升VLA策略的推理吞吐和闭环性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接针对VLA策略的推理延迟问题，通过世界模型预测感知记忆来协调异步执行，增强了视觉-语言-动作策略的实时性和鲁棒性。

papers.abstract: Tools with different shapes can have similar functions, but transferring manipulation skills across tools requires understanding how tool geometry relates to the specific task and adjusting the manipulation strategy accordingly. The key challenge is to discover the common affordances that contribute to task completion across different tools and verify whether they support new tools in performing similar work. We present A$^2$-VLA, a tool-adaptation framework that combines an embodied agent with a VLA policy. It treats tool affordances as hypotheses the agent can construct, test, and revise. Given teleoperated demonstrations with a few source tools, the agent reconstructs the scenes in simulation and autonomously determines task-relevant affordance features: functional regions and their key geometric properties. It develops affordance-extraction skills and refines both the features and skills through autonomous experiments in the reconstructed scenes. Validated extraction skills accumulate in a reusable skill library for unseen tools. Finally, A$^2$-VLA uses encoded functional-region features as conditioning inputs to a $\pi_{0.5}$ backbone during training and inference. Evaluation examines affordance reliability in reconstructed scenes and real-robot task success on unseen tools. Our method achieves 86.1% success in simulated cross-tool trajectory retargeting based on affordances. On three real-robot tool-use tasks, A$^2$-VLA improves task success by 30.7 percentage points over $\pi_{0.5}$.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真跨工具轨迹重定向中达到86.1%的成功率；在三个真实机器人工具使用任务中，相比π0.5提高了30.7个百分点的任务成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了A$^2$-VLA框架，结合具身代理与VLA策略，通过自主发现工具的可供性特征来适应新工具。
analysis.method: 代理在仿真中重建演示场景，自主确定任务相关的功能区域及其关键几何属性，开发可供性提取技能，并通过自主实验优化；提取的功能区域特征作为条件输入到π0.5骨干网络进行训练和推理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种工具适应框架，通过代理式构建、测试和修正工具可供性假设，使VLA策略能够泛化到新工具。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究直接以VLA为核心，增强VLA策略对新工具的适应能力，通过代理式可供性发现为动作预测提供有效条件，对机器人操作和VLA领域具有高度相关性。

papers.abstract: Splice-Core is a temporal-unary/binary (tub) hybrid general matrix multiplication (GEMM) unit that minimizes low-order accumulation latency, while retaining value-dependent execution for high-order activation bits. We present two novel processing element (PE) variants: (i) Splice-BP utilizing bit planes, and (ii) Splice-LUT, which selects a shared weight multiple in a single cycle. Compared to a binary systolic array, Splice-BP/Splice-LUT achieve 77.4%/76.4% geometric-mean tile energy reductions, respectively, across 26 INT4 convolutional neural network (CNN) and large language model (LLM) workloads in 45nm. Splice-LUT further increases geometric-mean tile throughput by 44.4% and reduces geometric-mean energy-delay product (EDP) by 6.13x across the 26 configurations. Across the evaluated W8A8 convolution and expert-projection workloads, Splice-BP and Splice-LUT reduce tile energy by 77.3-88.1%. Post-place-and-route INT4 yields 14%/9% smaller area for Splice-BP/Splice-LUT, compared to the systolic array.

analysis.key_results: 在45nm工艺下，26个INT4 CNN和LLM工作负载中，Splice-BP/Splice-LUT分别实现77.4%/76.4%的几何平均tile能耗降低；Splice-LUT提升44.4%几何平均tile吞吐量，降低6.13倍几何平均能量延迟积；在W8A8卷积和专家投影工作负载中能耗降低77.3-88.1%；INT4布局后面积减少14%/9%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Splice-Core，一种混合时间一元/二进制GEMM单元，以及两种处理单元变体：Splice-BP和Splice-LUT。
analysis.method: 设计Splice-Core混合时间一元/二进制GEMM单元，提出Splice-BP（位平面）和Splice-LUT（单周期选择共享权重倍数）两种处理单元。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Splice-Core，一种混合时间一元/二进制GEMM单元，通过低位拼接降低累加延迟并提升能效。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文聚焦于GEMM硬件加速器的量化优化，未直接涉及VLA或WAM，但其高效推理方法对机器人模型部署具有潜在借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) predict how a scene will evolve and condition their actions on this predicted future. Deploying them on a robot's onboard computer calls for 4-bit weights, activations and key-value caches (W4A4KV4). Existing 4-bit quantizers for WAMs preserve the generated action, and estimate sensitivity one denoising step at a time. However, they fail to preserve the fidelity of the predicted future: once the action pathway is protected, the remaining action error enters mostly through a degraded future that none of them deliberately protects. We propose LAQ, a latent-aware quantization framework that preserves the predicted future where it is written, stored and read. Specifically, we introduce a reader metric, which measures future error by its effect on the action, and a read count, which weights each rounding error by the number of denoising steps that read it. Together they give the allocation of precision over activations and caches a closed-form solution. We further develop gaze-guided refinement, which gives the tokens the action attends to a second 4-bit pass in the denoising loop and in the cache. All weights stay at 4 bits, with no high-precision branch and no per-task recalibration. On the LIBERO-Plus benchmark, LAQ reaches 76.4% and 83.3% average success on Fast-WAM and Cosmos-Policy, within 1.2 percentage points of the 16-bit models and all above the baselines with 16-bit KV caches. It compresses the model by 3.8x, reduces the peak GPU memory of the whole policy by 2.3x, and runs 1.66x faster than the 16-bit model. On a real AgileX PiPER arm, it reaches 47.0% average success over three tasks, against 52.0% for the 16-bit model and 30.0% higher than QuaRot.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO-Plus基准上，LAQ使Fast-WAM和Cosmos-Policy达到76.4%和83.3%的平均成功率，与16位模型相差1.2个百分点以内；模型压缩3.8倍，峰值GPU内存降低2.3倍，运行速度提高1.66倍；在真实AgileX PiPER机械臂上平均成功率为47.0%，高于QuaRot 30.0个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出LAQ（latent-aware quantization）框架，通过reader metric和read count实现精度分配的闭式解，以及gaze-guided refinement，实现W4A4KV4量化而不损失未来保真度和动作性能。
analysis.method: LAQ框架：使用reader metric测量未来误差对动作的影响；read count根据读取次数加权舍入误差；gaze-guided refinement为动作关注的token在去噪循环和缓存中提供第二次4位处理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出LAQ框架，通过保护预测未来的读写过程，对世界动作模型进行W4A4KV4量化，在保持动作成功率的同时大幅压缩模型。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对世界动作模型（WAM）的量化，属于本站核心主题；提出的量化方法在保持动作性能的同时大幅提升推理效率，可直接应用于机器人策略部署。

papers.abstract: Multimodal foundation models are advancing embodied navigation, but frequent inference incurs substantial computational cost. We present Cognitive-Horizon Action Chunking (CHAC), a training-free framework for memory-guided adaptive reasoning with a frozen navigation policy. Retained visual context, completion cues, and controller feedback determine the cognitive horizon, or how many cached waypoints the robot executes before refreshing its prediction. At the policy's stop request, local visitation history guides a bounded correction with at most one extra movement and no additional model calls. CHAC reduces vision-language model calls by 33.4% on HM3D-OVON and 64.7% on R2R-CE, with success-rate decreases of 0.63 and 10.82 percentage points, respectively. Success rate and success weighted by path length improve per model call on both benchmarks. Across four physical navigation tasks with 40 runs per method, CHAC achieves 18 successes versus 14 for native execution, reducing model calls by 54.9% and GPU inference time by 49.7%.

analysis.key_results: CHAC在HM3D-OVON上减少视觉语言模型调用33.4%（成功率下降0.63个百分点），在R2R-CE上减少64.7%（成功率下降10.82个百分点）；在两个基准上每次模型调用的成功率和成功加权路径长度均有改善；物理导航任务中18次成功对比本地执行的14次，模型调用减少54.9%，GPU推理时间减少49.7%。
analysis.limitations: R2R-CE上成功率下降10.82个百分点，但摘要未明确说明其他局限。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出认知视界动作分块（CHAC）框架，在冻结导航策略基础上，根据视觉上下文、完成线索和控制器反馈自适应确定认知视界，并在策略请求停止时进行有界修正，减少模型调用。
analysis.method: 训练无关的CHAC框架；保留视觉上下文、完成线索和控制器反馈决定认知视界，缓存路点执行直到需要刷新预测；在停止请求时利用局部访问历史引导最多一次额外移动的修正，无需额外模型调用。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出训练无关的记忆引导自适应推理框架，通过缓存路点和局部访问历史减少视觉语言模型调用，提升具身导航效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 与VLA/WAM没有直接关系，但通过缓存视觉语言模型的预测动作块减少推理次数，与speculative decoding在高层面上共享减少模型调用的目标，可视为动作层面的高效推理策略。
